applies_why: The judge text makes Isaiah 7:14 UNDERDETERMINED by separating its virgin and young-woman wording from its prophetic application, treating a verse with two senses as open.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand: one reading forbids UNDERDETERMINED when the verse can carry both senses; the other permits UNDERDETERMINED whenever each side addresses a different sense.
why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED rests on the two senses of Isaiah 7:14 instead of letting both senses stand, so it breaks K-S2.
